aiVerification.summary: The workbook is citeable, but the draft overstates the baseline comparison and includes unsupported measurement outcomes.
issues: Normal baseline is cited only in function results, not laser, bending, or VP/CD sections.
Changed factor mixes all test molds against one normal mold without proving comparability.
Unsupported domains include coating and dimension/spec.
Header-derived measurement outcomes are misclassified and not supported by data-row citations.
Date, line, process step, and mold number subgroup keys are not preserved enough.
requiredUserQuestions: Should Normal VP mold #2 be used as baseline for all test molds or only function results?
Are mold numbers #2,#3,#4,#5,#7,#9,#10 comparable test subgroups under one improvement?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP mold improvement/test lot IR240823013 only if supported.
Use mold number, date, line, and process step as subgroup keys.
Limit baseline comparison to rows where Normal VP mold #2 is cited or mark no baseline.
Remove pseudo-measurement outcomes or rebuild them as defect subtype counts from data rows.
Revise evidence to cite section headers plus all relevant test and baseline data rows.
